title: Glaukos Receives Permanent J-code for Epioxa™
summary: New J-code for Epioxa ™ , J2789, set to become effective July 1, 2026 Glaukos Corporation (NYSE: GKOS), an ophthalmic pharmaceutical and medical technology company focused on novel therapies for the treatment of glaucoma, corneal disorders, and retinal diseases, announced today the U.S. Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) has assigned a unique, permanent Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) J-code for Epioxa™ HD / Epioxa™ (“Epioxa”) for the treatment of keratoconus, a rare, sight-threatening disease that is currently far too often undiagnosed and untreated. The new J-code for Epioxa, J2789, is set to become effective July 1, 2026.
